description: Image Description: The image shows a set of traffic lights mounted on a vertical pole. The lights are arranged in a horizontal configuration, with two sets facing opposite directions. Each set consists of three lights, and the casing is painted a bright yellow-orange color. In the background, there is a multi-story building with brickwork and several windows, some of which have external metal fire escape staircases. The sky is clear and blue, indicating a sunny day. Additionally, there are some rooftop structures and antennas
